analysis:
The PR adds one optional counter, `cancellationsPartialComplete`, to the local diagnostic `DaemonState.Stats` (DaemonStateFile.swift, lines 130-142 on head). ProviderLoop+Trust.swift passes it through at lines 69-70 of `currentDaemonState()`. The counter is a scalar UInt64 holding an aggregate count of early-ended requests. It carries no prompt content, key material, account identifiers or other per-request identity, so it adds no exposure to A-001, A-003 or A-015.

The field is optional, so older readers and writers still decode (`convertFromSnakeCase`, schema unchanged at 1). The state file stays a best-effort diagnostic written via atomic `Data.write`, with no new trust boundary, no change to authorization, and no change to attestation or encryption. The `trust` and `authorization` diagnostic handling, `clearConnectionAuthorization` and `handleTrustStatus` are unchanged in behavior, so T-052 and T-053 are unaffected.

The doc comment says the coordinator "may not pay for" these requests. That is informational only. Billing is platform-owned and out of scope for this repository.

Open question for integration: the diff does not include where `stats.cancellationsPartialComplete` is defined or incremented (the provider-loop stats struct). That definition is outside the supplied units, so its accuracy and any cancellation or billing semantics were not verified. No security regression is visible in the supplied hunks.
